5. Repeat this cycle for several minutes.

challenges that they are facing, and I'll also give some insights on why the new generation of APM is different, and how it can help them to overcome these challenges.
In my previous blog post on APM, I discussed how the traditional APM solutions were limited by the need for agents on the application and the infrastructure to monitor it. These solutions were mainly focused on transaction and error monitoring. But now, the world of IT has changed. With the emergence of cloud computing, microservices, containers, and serverless architectures, the IT landscape has become more complex and dynamic. Traditional APM tools are no longer sufficient to meet the demands of modern applications.
One of the main challenges that customers are facing with their old APM solutions is the lack of visibility into the entire application and infrastructure. the nature of values education in New Zealand schools.

It is an important contribution to the national conversation on values education and democracy.
The report identifies three main areas of concern in relation to values education in our schools: the place of values in the school curriculum, the role of schools in promoting values, and the role of the state in promoting values.
First, the report says that values education must be an integral part of the curriculum. Currently, there is no explicit curriculum in New Zealand schools for values education, which the report argues is a significant omission.
While there are values referenced in many different subjects, the report points out that values are often not given the attention they deserve. For instance, values such as respect, integrity and justice are not always clearly addressed in the curriculum, and there is a lack of consistent teaching strategies
